notes.title: Auto-Follow Stone Option Added
notes.content:
Added option for player to be able to automatically follow the stone after it is thrown.  This should make playability easier for new players or players using controllers without a thumbstick.

Also minor fixes/improvements.

tags.feature: Added option for player to be able to automatically follow the stone after it is thrown.

notes.title: New option to auto-follow stones
notes.content:
Added new option to automatically follow stones after throwing (on by default) which should make playability much easier for newer players or those using controllers without thumbsticks.

Various other minor fixes/improvements.

tags.feature: Added new option to automatically follow stones after throwing (on by default) which should make playability much easier for newer players or those using controllers without thumbsticks.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
With the latest update, you can now rotate 90 degrees to the left or right in the arena.  There are buttons just to the left of the ice when you first start a game.  Click on either the left or right arrows to rotate either direction.  Hopefully this will allow players to find the optimal direction for their specific gaming setups.

Thanks,
Brian

notes.title: Physics Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

I've gotten a few comments that the stones tend to move too much as they are coming to a stop.  I've made some adjustments to the physics to try and address this.  Please let me know what you think.

Thanks!
Brian
